scope: Definition and bounded regression interface, not a common physical constructor or universal compatibility theorem.

source_binding.policy: Both routes bind the same source record, not just the same type, dimension, current scalar or chosen law.
source_binding.hidden_choices: Any seed, metric, clock, normalization, mesh or source selection is part of parameters; undeclared choices invalidate a binding.

route_contract.typed_square: phi_i A_source = A_i phi_i on the declared common domain for each licensed operation, including domain/availability guards.
route_contract.cross_route_square: C phi_math = phi_process only where an independently specified typed comparison C exists; dimension agreement does not supply C.
route_contract.composition: Compose only when target/source types, intermediate domains, guards, context and resource policy match; retain the actual witnesses.
route_contract.observation: Compare o_i phi_i on the same source record with explicit units/normalization and uncertainty policy; matching present outputs alone is not transport.

identity_contract.complete_identity: Source values, retained distinctions, provenance and archive agree; lossy readers do not replace complete identity.
identity_contract.task_identity: x~y iff operation-availability profiles agree along every licensed finite continuation word AND all task observations agree under the frozen domain/context/resource policy; unequal guards are distinguishable, not vacuous agreement.
identity_contract.quotient_admission: A task reader is usable as predictive state only if its equivalence is a congruence for the licensed operations and availability guards.
identity_contract.context_change: Adding restoration, interactions, phase readout, new gain rules or resource availability requires a new equivalence review.
identity_contract.archive_policy: Hidden records remain retained even at a zero forward-task readout. Restoration is not automatically in the forward task.

physical_admission: Every required premise needs independent typed evidence and review. A mathematical square, analogy, positive norm or finite test is not such an admission.

WG_energy_binding.source: Existing real factored shared-leg field, 137 retained leaves and histories, supplied native drift and common family gain.
mathematical_routes: complete retained T9 with actual decoder L
WG_energy_binding.protocol: Free drift and finite forward family-gain schedules, 0<=q<=1, common q for both routes; no independent response-cell writes.
WG_energy_binding.task_equivalence: Equality of (a,b) when the context permits a known nontrivial gain 0<q<1; not complete source identity.
WG_energy_binding.hostile: Actual invertible preparations have equal family means and current H=7436 but next H=1859 and 1859/4 at q=1/2.
WG_energy_binding.physical_status: All six premises remain unjustified by this binding; mathematical preparation hostiles are not lab preparations with equal physical resource budgets.
